sections.body:
I work in the **MLAI Lab** (Machine Learning & Artificial Intelligence Lab) with Professor Sung Ju Hwang. My research centers on generative weight-space learning, neural network synthesis, and AutoML: encoding pretrained model weights into structured latent representations, generative modeling over those representations (diffusion, flow matching, autoregressive models, VAEs), and transfer across architectures. The long-term goal is a generative AutoML system that synthesizes high-performing network weights directly from architectural specifications, reducing training cost and making model development more accessible.

I received my PhD from KAIST in February 2026 with the thesis *Weight-Space Learning as a Foundation for Deep AutoML*.

items.text: Received a Google TPU Research Award for *Generative AutoML*.

pages.title: Research
pages.subtitle: Generative weight-space learning, neural network synthesis, and AutoML.

items.title: Generative Weight Synthesis
items.text: Generating neural network weights with diffusion, flow matching, and autoregressive models, conditioned on architecture or task.

items.title: Latent Representations of Model Weights
items.text: Encoding pretrained weights into structured latent spaces with VAEs and autoencoders, as a basis for generation, merging, and analysis.

items.title: Latent-Space Model Merging
items.text: Merging models in a learned latent space with optimal transport alignment (LS-Merge), extended toward mixture-of-experts compression.

items.title: Configuration-to-Weights Generation
items.text: Synthesizing weights directly from architectural specifications, with transfer across model families and scales.

pages.title: Publications
pages.subtitle: Peer-reviewed papers, preprints, and thesis. Full list on Google Scholar.

items.title: LS-Merge: Merging Language Models in Latent Space
items.authors: **Bedionita Soro**, Aoxuan Silvia Zhang, Bruno Andreis, Jaehyeong Jo, Song Chong, Sung Ju Hwang
items.tldr: Encodes model weights into a latent space with a transformer VAE, merges there, and decodes back, enabling merging across different model sizes and architectures.

items.title: SLEM: Spectrum-Aware Latent Expert Merging
items.authors: Dohyeon Kim, **Bedionita Soro**, Bruno Andreis, Sung Ju Hwang
items.tldr: Compresses mixture-of-experts models by grouping, matching, and merging experts in a learned latent space with spectrum-aware merging coefficients.

items.title: Distribution-Consistent Inference for Dynamic Sparse Mixture-of-Experts
items.authors: Dohyeon Kim, **Bedionita Soro**, Sung Ju Hwang
items.tldr: Layer-wise distribution alignment keeps sparse MoE outputs consistent when the number of active experts changes at inference time.

items.title: Diffusion-Based Neural Network Weights Generation (D2NWG)
items.authors: **Bedionita Soro**, Bruno Andreis, Hayeon Lee, Wonyong Jeong, Song Chong, Frank Hutter, Sung Ju Hwang
items.tldr: A latent diffusion model that generates network weights conditioned on a dataset or architecture, for unseen tasks.

items.title: Instruction-Guided Autoregressive Neural Network Parameter Generation (IGPG)
items.authors: **Bedionita Soro**, Bruno Andreis, Song Chong, Sung Ju Hwang
items.tldr: A VQ-VAE plus autoregressive transformer that generates parameters from task descriptions and architecture specifications. Workshop on Neural Network Weights as a New Data Modality.

items.title: Set-based Neural Network Encoding Without Weight Tying (SNE)
items.authors: Bruno Andreis, **Bedionita Soro**, Philip H. S. Torr, Sung Ju Hwang
items.tldr: Encodes neural network weights as sets, enabling property prediction across architectures without weight tying.

items.title: Enhancing Differentiable Architecture Search: A Study on Small Number of Cell Blocks in the Search Stage, and Important Branches-Based Cells Selection
items.tldr: Searches DARTS cells with a single normal and reduction cell plus an auxiliary residual connection, cutting search cost.

items.title: A Wavelet Scattering Feature Extraction Approach for Deep Neural Network Based Indoor Fingerprinting Localization
items.tldr: Wavelet scattering features of RSSI signals feed a deep neural network for indoor positioning.
